scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @novel-tool/api" "npm run dev -w @novel-tool/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @novel-tool/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @novel-tool/api && npm run build -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @novel-tool/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.check: npm run check:arch && npm run check:crawler && npm run check:web-arch && npm run check:web-contracts && npm run check:docs && npm run format:check && npm run check -w @novel-tool/shared && npm run build:shared && npm run check -w @novel-tool/api && npm run check -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.check:api: npm run check -w @novel-tool/shared && npm run build:shared && npm run check -w @novel-tool/api
scripts.check:web: npm run check -w @novel-tool/shared && npm run build:shared && npm run check -w @novel-tool/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration:prepared
scripts.verify: npm run check:lockfile && npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:regression && npm run test:integration:prepared
